info.title: Closet API
info.description: Closet's JSON API for native clients. Sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/token and send the device token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A 401 on any route means sign in again. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json; switch on `code`.

deviceToken.description: A device token from POST /api/v1/auth/token, valid until revoked.

post.summary: Sign a device in: a device token for this account

delete.summary: Sign this device out: revoke the calling token

get.summary: Who the token acts as, and the household day

200.description: The account the token acts as

schema.title: Me
schema.description: The account the token acts as

get.summary: A wardrobe's garments, filtered as the grid filters them
get.description: The closet (with `includeArchived` the archive too; never the wishlist), newest first. A type without its category is a 400; `needsWash` on a shared wardrobe is a 403; a capsule outside the wardrobe a 404.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: A wardrobe shared with you (its owner's id); absent, your own

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Matches the name, brand and notes

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: A type of `category`, which it needs

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: Also garments no longer in the closet

parameters.name: needsWash
parameters.description: Only garments with a copy that needs a wash: your own wardrobe only

parameters.name: needsAttention
parameters.description: Only garments that need repair or replacing soon

parameters.name: needsTagging
parameters.description: Only closet garments still missing their type, warmth or formality

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many a page holds: 48 unless asked, at most 100

200.description: A page of the wardrobe, newest first

post.summary: Adds a garment, without its photo
post.description: To your wardrobe or one shared with you to MANAGE (VIEW is a 403). Saved by the garment form's rules: a blank category or a bad date is a 400 naming the field. The photo is its own upload.

schema.description: Lands in the closet unless `destination` says the wishlist. Saved by the garment form's rules (a new type brings its presets)

size.description: As on the label (XL is stored as X-Large)

conditionNote.description: What is wrong: kept only while the condition is not good

materials.description: The whole set; new materials preset the care label where it was unset or still at the old materials' care

patch.summary: Changes a garment's fields, properties, care label and condition
patch.description: Only the fields sent: absent leaves one as stored, null clears it. Saved by the garment form's rules (a new type brings its presets, a new category drops what its role lacks: `ignored` names them). Your own wardrobe or a MANAGE share; the wash limit is the owner's alone.

delete.summary: Deletes a garment and its photo
delete.description: The owner only: a share, MANAGE included, is a 403. A garment already gone is a 404, which a retry may read as done. A Muse suggestion is a 409: it is set aside, never deleted.

parameters.description: A wardrobe shared with you (its owner's id); absent, your own

put.description: The owner only. `archived` takes a closet garment out of the closet, `closet` brings an archived one back; one already there is answered as it is. Anything else (a wishlist item) is a 409: "Bought it" is the wishlist's.

post.summary: Copies a garment into your own wardrobe
post.description: Any garment you can see, a VIEW share included: the copy is yours, with its photo. The body changes what differs from the source (absent, the name is "<name> (cloned)"). The source's owner-only wash limit is not copied from a share.

patch.description: The tagging queue's tap (GET /garments?needsTagging=true lists it): only what differs is written, and a new type fills its presets where nothing was set or still at the old type's. A type not of the category is a 400. Your own wardrobe or a MANAGE share.
